description: This source file contains utility functions related to error handling and logging for the export database system in a PyTorch project. It defines functions to generate error messages based on case names and classify exceptions related to export errors.

methods.name: str exportdb_error_message(case_name: str)
methods.description: Generates a formatted error message indicating whether a case name is registered in the export database, providing a link to documentation if registered, or logging an error if not.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_class_if_classified_error(e: Exception)
methods.description: Analyzes an Exception to determine if it is classified as a particular export-related error, returning a case name string if classified, or None otherwise.
